_note: World events for Contractor: Fallen (docs/survival_events.md, call 124). The sim rolls at most one a world day: chance_per_day x the New world 'world' option (world_mult), then a kind by weight. Each kind: weight, window_h (how long it stays open), pressure (raised in its zone), text (the event's line: {place} {zone} {to} {group} filled in), and its own numbers. loot: [[item id, min, max], ...] rolled `rolls` times into the cache it leaves. Every number is Proposed.

supply_drop.label: Supply drop
supply_drop.text: a supply drop came down by {place} in {zone}
supply_drop.broadcast: the enclave on the emergency band: a supply drop is down by {place} in {zone}; it belongs to the enclave
supply_drop.taken: {group} got to the supply drop in {zone} first
supply_drop.lapsed: the supply drop in {zone} was picked clean by someone nobody saw

convoy.label: Convoy wagon
convoy.text: a {column} column is moving along the road through {zone} toward {to}
convoy.robbed: someone robbed the {column} column's wagon in {zone}

heli_down.label: Helicopter wreck
heli_down.text: a helicopter came down by {place} in {zone}; smoke for miles
heli_down.broadcast: the enclave asks after a crew down by {place} in {zone}: bring them home and be paid
heli_down.recovered: the enclave took its crew back from the wreck in {zone}
heli_down.lost: the crew of the wreck in {zone} were never found

bell.label: Bell
bell.text: a bell rang for an hour in {zone}
bell.cult_text: {group} rang the bell in {zone} to call the dead

burning.label: Fire
burning.out: the fire in {zone} has burned itself out

storm.label: Storm
storm.text: a storm took the bridge between {zone} and {to} out
storm.passing: the storm has passed; the crossing between {zone} and {to} is still down
